title: What if you gave up on Barça in January 2015? (cartoon story)

scenes.text: What if you gave up on Barça... in January 2015?
January 4th. Barcelona lose 1-0 at Real Sociedad. Messi and Neymar start on the bench.
The next day, Messi misses training. The papers say he wants out. And the sporting director gets sacked.
His mate has seen enough. He sells his Barça shirt. For 10 euros.
But our guy keeps his. Because Barça have a secret weapon. Actually... three of them.
Messi. Suárez. Neymar. The striker who got banned for biting a player at the World Cup... is now part of the scariest front three on the planet.
May 2015. Bayern Munich. Messi goes past Boateng, who falls to the ground... and chips it over Neuer.
They win the league. Then, in the cup final, Messi dribbles past half of Athletic Bilbao... and scores.
June 6th. Berlin. The Champions League final, against Juventus.
Rakitić scores. Morata equalises. Then Suárez. And Neymar, in the very last minute.
BARCELONA WIN THE TREBLE! The first club ever to do it twice!
Messi, Suárez and Neymar scored 122 goals that season.
And his mate? He tried to buy his shirt back... for 100 euros. Follow for more What Ifs.
